title: S02T03 - Capture witnessed command, Git, environment, and artifact provenance
description: Record exit status, duration, bounded output excerpts, full-output hashes, Git state, tool versions, artifacts, and expected-observable results as atomic evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: A witnessed run persists command, cwd, exit code, timeout state, byte counts, hashes, excerpts, Git branch/SHA/dirty fingerprint, tool versions, and artifact hashes.
Failed or interrupted runs remain inspectable evidence and cannot satisfy a passed gate.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
